primary_decision: Current atom configuration failed to improve over the fixed, domain-mixing and ordinary-cluster controls. Keep fixed mixing as the practical baseline; do not expand this configuration into larger runs or RL.
followup_decision: Do not prioritize 02-only or confirmatory A/B interventions for this negative configuration. Any future bounded diagnosis should first test held-out group-response prediction and selection bias, before more full training.
limitations: One training seed and development users; paired user intervals do not quantify training-seed variability.
Fixed-distribution importance-gradient estimates are unbiased over query sampling; maximizing them using the same queried records does not make the selected estimate unbiased.
No independent second gradient-query batch validated the selected mixture in this run. This is a possible failure mechanism, not an identified cause.
This implementation uses legal-readout partial-gradient sketches; negative results do not disprove every full-gradient atom method.
Stage cost excludes the common 800-step initialization and E005 baseline search. Preparation was executed once but is charged to each method requiring it.
No final-test evaluation or universal multi-domain conflict claim.
